reviewers: Claude Sonnet (independent worker, read-only) then Claude Opus 5.5 sign-off
not_executed: No SQL or provider fixture was re-run for this review except MP-06m. Findings come from reading the code and from Codex's existing receipts.

findings.worker_claim: P1: a provider refresh followed by a failed or interrupted rotation save orphans a live provider session forever; interactive login/refresh recovery is best-effort only (3 s).
findings.opus_adjudication: UPDATE 2026-09-26: confirmed P3 by the provider's own documentation. https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/sessions states: 'If the parent of the currently active refresh token for the user's session is being used, the active token will be returned' (no time limit, separate from the 10 s reuse interval). The hosted re-probe stays as confirmation. Original note: downgraded to P3 as a JUDGMENT PENDING A PROBE, not a proven result. (1) Cleanup path: the stored envelope stays the direct parent of the unsaved child. evidence/MP-08o2-parent-reuse.txt proves pinned GoTrue returns the same active child when the parent is replayed after 11 s. A cleanup retry cannot happen sooner than the 30-second claim floor and may come minutes or hours later, so 'the next claim can refresh, save and log out that child' is inferred for those delays, not shown. If replay fails after a long delay, the worker's P1 stands. The residual window is already documented in MP-08o-plan.md L37 and needs a hosted re-probe (added to the DP-14 checklist). (2) Interactive refresh: the durable row keeps the parent envelope, so the same replay applies. (3) Interactive login where bff_session_create fails: the provider tokens exist only in the dead process's memory and are never stored or sent to the browser, so no party can use them. The remaining effect is an unreachable auth.sessions row until provider expiry.
findings.action: Confirm the downgrade: rerun the direct-parent replay probe locally with delays of at least 30 s and several minutes, and again on the hosted DP-14 spike. The queued Codex review should explicitly confirm or reject this P3 downgrade. Optionally sweep orphan auth.sessions rows later.

findings.action: Add form-action 'self'. Route /sign-in through the BFF before hosted sign-in; do not widen connect-src.
